note.en: Wang previewed Muse Wonder, Meta Superintelligence Labs' first major model since the group formed, describing a year of pre-training and infrastructure scaling behind it.
note.zh: Wang 预告了Meta超级智能实验室（MSL）成立以来的首个重磅模型「Muse Wonder」，介绍了过去一年在预训练与基础设施扩展上的工作。

title.en: introducing muse wonder our new frontier model. state-of-the-art at personal agents and professional agents. our largest and most capable model yet—rivals the b
title.zh: introducing muse wonder our new frontier model. state-of-the-art at personal agents and professional agents. our largest and most capable model yet—rivals the b

note.en: Wang announced Muse Wonder, Meta's new frontier model positioned as its largest and most capable yet, aimed at personal and professional agents.
note.zh: Wang 宣布推出 Muse Wonder，这是 Meta 迄今最大、最强的前沿模型，面向个人与专业智能体场景。

title.en: "it is a surprising model. on every technical benchmark we ran it was neck and neck or better than astra, fable and opus." "meta is going to win consumer agents
title.zh: "it is a surprising model. on every technical benchmark we ran it was neck and neck or better than astra, fable and opus." "meta is going to win consumer agents

note.en: Wang claimed Meta's new Muse Wonder model is competitive with or better than Astra, Fable and Opus on benchmarks, and predicted Meta would win consumer agents.

title.zh: MUSE WONDER 🍉 this model was developed to power personal agents. three highlights: - ACTIVE MEMORY: best memory across days/weeks/months - ACTIVE FOCUS: gets yo

note.en: Wang detailed Muse Wonder's three capabilities — long-horizon active memory, active focus on completing tasks, and domain expertise — as Meta's new personal-agent model.
note.zh: 王介绍了Meta新个人智能体模型Muse Wonder的三大能力：跨数周数月的主动记忆、专注完成任务的主动聚焦，以及领域专业能力。

title.zh: 🍉 MUSE WONDER 🍉 our research process starts with evals. we developed the Personal Superintelligence Index (PSI) internally to help us measure the important dime

note.en: Wang detailed Meta Superintelligence Labs' internally-built evaluation framework, the Personal Superintelligence Index (PSI), used to guide Muse Wonder's development.
note.zh: 王介绍了Meta超级智能实验室自研的评估体系——个人超级智能指数（PSI），用于指导Muse Wonder模型的研发。

title.en: with muse wonder, we aimed to build a model that is useful for real world tasks for real people, informed by our product adoption and how people use muse. we fo
title.zh: with muse wonder, we aimed to build a model that is useful for real world tasks for real people, informed by our product adoption and how people use muse. we fo

note.en: Wang explains the design philosophy behind Muse Wonder, saying Meta built it for real-world usefulness based on product-adoption signals rather than chasing benchmarks.
note.zh: 王阐述了Muse Wonder的设计理念：Meta基于产品采用数据而非追逐基准测试，专注于让模型在真实世界任务中真正好用。

title.en: whole team feels dumb now, but it's true, we did not explicitly train our model on 3d demo games obviously in retrospect we probably should've done a bit of tha
title.zh: whole team feels dumb now, but it's true, we did not explicitly train our model on 3d demo games obviously in retrospect we probably should've done a bit of tha

note.en: Wang admits the Muse Wonder team didn't explicitly train on 3D demo games and in hindsight should have, while still encouraging people to try the model.

title.en: we have identified and fixed the issue that was causing the unusually fast quota usage for muse wonder and muse wonder full. you will now see much lower usage a
title.zh: we have identified and fixed the issue that was causing the unusually fast quota usage for muse wonder and muse wonder full. you will now see much lower usage a

title.en: we are fixing issues as fast as we can see them! there's definitely still issues we're trying to iron out, but thank you to everyone for giving us a bit of time
title.zh: we are fixing issues as fast as we can see them! there's definitely still issues we're trying to iron out, but thank you to everyone for giving us a bit of time

title.zh: Alexandr Wang says Meta's finally catching up to OpenAI

body.en: Wang, Meta's Chief AI Officer, publicly claimed Meta's AI efforts are closing the gap with OpenAI, a competitive positioning statement during Meta Superintelligence Labs' restructuring.
body.zh: 作为Meta首席AI官，Wang公开表示Meta的AI能力正在追赶OpenAI，这是在Meta超级智能实验室重组期间的一次竞争定位表态。

title.en: Alexandr Wang: Meta AI Boss Drops "Health-First' Bombshell In Battle With OpenAI, Google And Anthropic
title.zh: Alexandr Wang: Meta AI Boss Drops "Health-First' Bombshell In Battle With OpenAI, Google And Anthropic

body.en: At Bloomberg Tech in June 2026, Wang said Meta's future AI models will differentiate on consumer health capabilities, citing early results from Muse Spark as Meta's answer to OpenAI, Google and Anthropic.
body.zh: 2026年6月，王在Bloomberg Tech大会上表示，Meta未来的AI模型将以消费者健康能力作为差异化方向，并以Muse Spark的早期成果作为应对OpenAI、谷歌和Anthropic竞争的策略。

title.en: Meta unveils Muse Spark, its first AI model since hiring Alexandr Wang and a bellwether for CEO Mark Zuckerberg’s multibillion-dollar AI push
title.zh: Meta unveils Muse Spark, its first AI model since hiring Alexandr Wang and a bellwether for CEO Mark Zuckerberg’s multibillion-dollar AI push

body.en: Meta released Muse Spark, its first AI model since hiring Wang, seen as an early signal of his impact on Zuckerberg's AI strategy.
body.zh: Meta发布了自聘请Alexandr Wang以来的首个AI模型Muse Spark，被视为他影响扎克伯格AI战略的早期信号。

title.en: Meta releases Muse Spark, the first model from Alexandr Wang's AI team
title.zh: Meta releases Muse Spark, the first model from Alexandr Wang's AI team

body.en: Meta shipped Muse Spark, the first model released by Alexandr Wang's Superintelligence Labs team.
body.zh: Meta发布了Muse Spark，这是Alexandr Wang领导的超级智能实验室团队发布的首个模型。

title.en: Meta will soon release new AI models developed by Alexandr Wang
title.zh: Meta will soon release new AI models developed by Alexandr Wang

body.en: Meta is preparing to release new AI models developed under Alexandr Wang's leadership, an early product signal from his Superintelligence Labs.
body.zh: Meta即将发布由Alexandr Wang领导团队开发的新AI模型，这是其超级智能实验室的早期产品信号。

title.en: Meta Shuts Down Rumors Mark Zuckerberg Sidelined Chief AI Officer Alexandr Wang, Spokesperson Calls Repor
title.zh: Meta Shuts Down Rumors Mark Zuckerberg Sidelined Chief AI Officer Alexandr Wang, Spokesperson Calls Repor

body.en: Meta denied reports that Zuckerberg had sidelined Chief AI Officer Alexandr Wang, addressing speculation about his standing inside the company.
body.zh: Meta否认了扎克伯格边缘化首席AI官Alexandr Wang的传闻，回应了外界对其在公司内部地位的猜测。
